youtube.title: Does Cracking Your Knuckles Cause Arthritis? 🤞 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
One doctor cracked the knuckles of only one hand for sixty years to settle an argument.

Dr Donald Unger cracked only his left hand's knuckles for about 60 years. Neither hand got arthritis, and he won an Ig Nobel Prize. The pop is a gas bubble forming in the joint fluid when the joint is pulled apart.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
